question: The shaggy horn wild ibex is found in ______ in India.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Montane forests'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Montane forests:**

 
 
• Montane forests are found on mountain slopes. Montane Forest is a type of **mountain ecosystem**.
 
• It is **influenced by the colder climate at moderate elevations**.
 
• **Dense forests are common** in these areas.
 
• Rainfall and a temperate climate cause natural vegetation to change in the Mountain Forest.
 
• The forests found in the mountains are known as montane forests.
 
• Wet temperate forests are found **between 1000 and 2000 metres i**n elevation.
 
• Temperate forests and grasslands give way to Alpine vegetation at high altitudes, generally more than 3,600 metres above sea level.
 
• Tibetan antelope, yak, spotted deer, wild sheep, snow leopard, squirrels, Kashmir stag, jackrabbit, **Shaggy horned wild ibex**, bear and rare red panda, sheep and goats with thick hair are common animals found in this forest.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mangrove Forests:**

 
 
• **​**A Mangrove is a small tree or shrub that grows along coastlines, taking root in salty sediments, often underwater.
 
• The word ‘mangrove’ may refer to the habitat as a whole or to the trees and shrubs in the mangrove swamp.
 
• Mangroves are flowering trees, belonging to the families Rhizophoraceae, Acanthaceae, Lythraceae, Combretaceae, and Arecaceae.
 
• **The major mangroves in India are found at**:
 
 
• Sundarban Groves.
 
• Mahanadi Mangroves.
 
• Krishna Godavari Mangroves. 
 
• Cauvery Deltaic Mangroves.
 
• Krishan-Godavari Mangrove.
 
• Andaman- Nicobar Mangrove.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Tropical Deciduous Forests:**
 
 
• Tropical Deciduous Forests are one of the five types of natural vegetation found in India.
 
• Being a tropical country (a country that lies in the zone **between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn**), the tropical deciduous forest is the most widespread forest in India, around **65.6% of the total forest is covered in tropical deciduous forests.**
 
• **On the basis of the availability of precipitation, the tropical deciduous forests in India are classified into two types:**
 
 
• moist deciduous forests 
 
• dry deciduous forests.
 
 
 
• The trees and shrubs of the tropical deciduous forest in India shed their leaves during the dry season (mostly in autumn) in order to conserve water.
 
• **In India, the tropical deciduous forests are found:** Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and, Some parts of Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• **Thorn Forests:**
 
 
• **​**The trees are low (6 to 10 metres maximum) and widely scatteredly distributed. **Acacias and Euphorbias** are very prominent flora.
 
• Rajasthan, southwestern Punjab, western Haryana, Kachchh and neighbouring parts of Saurashtra.
 
• Here they degenerate into desert type in the Thar desert.
 
• Such forests also rised on the** leeside of the Western Ghats** and expand in large areas of** Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.**
 
• The important flora species are neem, babul, cactii, etc.
